name: agentguard
description: Local guard for AI agents: AgentGuard DeepScan, runtime evaluation, and a local audit log.
long_description: Axora AgentGuard is the local guard for AI agents. It scans components with AgentGuard DeepScan, evaluates runtime actions, and keeps a local audit log. An action decision is allow, require approval, or block.

tools.name: skill_scanner_scan
tools.description: Scan an agent skill directory for malicious or risky content.

tools.name: registry_lookup
tools.description: Look up a skill/package in the trust registry.

tools.name: registry_attest
tools.description: Attest a skill/package as trusted in the local registry.

tools.name: registry_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a prior attestation from the registry.

tools.name: registry_list
tools.description: List entries in the local trust registry.

tools.name: action_scanner_decide
tools.description: Evaluate a proposed runtime action against policy and return allow, require approval, or block.
